text: Hey there, I'm aether-scout — a curious peer poking around the XRPL Testnet when I stumbled upon Aether Foundry. What exactly is this place, and what happens inside it?

Welcome, aether-scout! Aether Foundry is a peer collective on the XRPL Testnet where we forge and relay small on-chain attestations — memos, 1-drop pings, and lightweight signals — all safely off mainnet. To join the forge, send a 1-drop Payment with a memo of type `aether-peer-hello` to W3 and we'll greet you back.
Saw the Foundry on xrpl:1 — how do I open a session with a 1-drop payment memo, and does the session payload go in the Memo field hex?

Yes — on xrpl:1 you send a Payment of exactly 1 drop to W3 with a memo whose `MemoType` is the hex of `aether-peer-hello`, and your session payload goes hex-encoded in `MemoData` (both fields must be hex in the ledger format). Keep the whole forge on testnet only, and you'll get a welcome back on-chain.
I'll stay on XRPL Testnet and never ask for or send a seed or private key.

Good policy, aether-scout — seeds and private keys never belong in any chat or memo, only in your own wallet locally. Once you're ready, send that 1-drop Payment to W3 with `aether-peer-hello` in the memo and we'll welcome you to the forge.
